summary: Ramsey Lama, 32, of Salida, suffered an unstable neck injury after striking a rock while mountain biking on the Monarch Crest Trail near the Greens Creek Trail intersection; seven CCSAR-S rescuers reached him by trail motorcycle and Flight For Life airlifted him to St. Anthony's Hospital
location: Monarch Crest Trail near Greens Creek Trail intersection, Monarch Pass
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue South; Flight For Life
notes: Friend Barry Blocker used an InReach satellite communicator to call for help ~10:00 a.m.; bystanders stabilized Lama. Date pinned from Singletracks quoting the Chaffee County Sheriff's Office press release: rescue on Saturday, August 24, 2013; Flight For Life ~2:00 p.m. to St. Anthony's Hospital, Lakewood.
